---
title: "Histology QC report"
output:
  html_document:
    toc: true
    toc_depth: 4
    toc_float: true
params:
  prep: ""
  exclusions: NULL
---

```{r setup, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE,
                      fig.retina = 1, dpi = 96)
prep <- readRDS(params$prep)
info <- prep$info
# Empty dates (end-point samples) are placed at the mouse's end date where the
# prep knows it (info$end_dates; NULL in older preps -> shown as "end").
# Exclusions match the sheet's dates, as at the export.
end_dates <- info$end_dates
data <- JanisHelpers:::qc_resolve_end_dates_(prep$data, end_dates)
n_end <- sum(is.na(prep$data$collected_at))
n_resolved <- n_end - sum(is.na(data$collected_at))
qc <- info$qc
group_col <- qc$group_col
batch_col <- qc$batch_col
log_scale <- FALSE
matched <- JanisHelpers:::match_sample_exclusions_(prep$data, params$exclusions, info$assay)
excluded_keys <- JanisHelpers:::qc_excluded_keys_(matched$excluded_samples, end_dates)
scored <- JanisHelpers:::qc_table_score_(data, "metric", group_col, log_scale)
rules_label <- if (length(qc$rules) == 0) "none" else paste(qc$rules, collapse = "; ")
or_unset <- function(x) if (is.null(x)) "not set" else paste0("`", x, "`")

emit_plot <- function(p) {
  if (is.null(p)) return(invisible(NULL))
  h <- JanisHelpers:::qc_fig_height_(length(unique(p$data$.row)))
  env <- new.env()
  env$p <- p
  wd <- getwd()
  on.exit(setwd(wd), add = TRUE)
  cat(knitr::knit_child(
    text = c(sprintf("```{r, fig.height = %s, fig.width = 10}", h), "print(p)", "```"),
    envir = env, quiet = TRUE
  ), "\n\n")
}
note <- function(...) cat("\n\n*", ..., "*\n\n", sep = "")
```

## Overview

| | |
|---|---|
| File | `r basename(info$source_path)` |
| Assay | `r info$assay` |
| File modified | `r if (file.exists(info$source_path)) format(file.mtime(info$source_path), "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M") else "not found"` |
| Prep result created | `r format(info$created_at, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M")` |
| JanisHelpers | `r info$package_version` |
| Group / batch column | `r or_unset(group_col)` / `r or_unset(batch_col)` |
| End-point dates | `r if (n_end == 0) "no empty dates" else if (is.null(end_dates)) "not given (empty dates shown as end)" else paste0(n_resolved, " of ", n_end, " empty-date rows placed at the end date")` |
| Sanity rules | `r rules_label` |

All samples are shown. Rows on the exclusions sheet are only flagged here (drawn as crosses on the point plots);
they are dropped at the final export.

```{r overview}
overview <- data |>
  dplyr::distinct(mouse_ID, tissue, collected_at) |>
  dplyr::mutate(timepoint = JanisHelpers:::qc_timepoint_(collected_at)) |>
  dplyr::summarise(n_samples = dplyr::n(), .by = c(tissue, timepoint)) |>
  dplyr::arrange(tissue, match(timepoint, JanisHelpers:::qc_timepoint_levels_(timepoint)))
knitr::kable(overview, caption = "Samples per tissue x timepoint")
```

## Completeness

End-point samples count only at the mouse's end date: a date with end-point
samples only expects the mice ending that day; a sampled (serial) date expects
every mouse still alive then.

```{r completeness, results = "asis"}
comp <- JanisHelpers:::qc_table_completeness_(prep$data, qc$expected_mice, end_dates)
unknown <- attr(comp, "unknown")
missing <- comp[comp$missing != "", ]
if (nrow(missing) == 0) {
  cat("None missing (", length(qc$expected_mice), " expected mice).\n", sep = "")
} else {
  cat("**Warning: expected mice missing.**\n\n")
  print(knitr::kable(missing))
}
if (length(unknown) > 0) {
  cat("\n\n**Warning: mice in the data that are not expected:** ",
      paste(unknown, collapse = ", "), ".\n\n", sep = "")
}
```

## Duplicate samples

```{r duplicates, results = "asis"}
dups <- JanisHelpers:::qc_duplicate_keys_(data, c("mouse_ID", "tissue", "collected_at", "metric"))
if (nrow(dups) == 0) {
  cat("No mouse_ID x tissue x date x metric occurs twice.\n")
} else {
  cat("**Warning: these mouse_ID x tissue x date x metric occur twice** (empty dates count as the ",
      "mouse's end date) -- the final export refuses them. Fix the curated ",
      "file (an end-point sample needs an empty date, not the end date).\n\n",
      sep = "")
  dups$collected_at <- JanisHelpers:::qc_timepoint_(dups$collected_at)
  print(knitr::kable(dups))
}
```

## Exclusions

```{r exclusions, results = "asis"}
if (nrow(matched$applicable) == 0) {
  cat("No exclusions apply to this assay.\n")
} else {
  cat("Flagged samples (dropped at the final export):\n\n")
  if (nrow(matched$excluded_samples) > 0) {
    print(knitr::kable(matched$excluded_samples))
  }
}
if (nrow(matched$unmatched) > 0) {
  cat("\n\n### Warning: these rows match no sample\n\n",
      "Check for typos -- the final export stops on them.",
      if (any(!is.na(matched$unmatched$collected_at))) {
        paste(" End-point samples have an empty date in the sheet --",
              "leave collected_at empty to target them.")
      },
      "\n\n")
  print(knitr::kable(matched$unmatched))
}
```

## Empty values

Empty (`NA`) values are missing measurements (e.g. a sample not scored).

```{r empty, results = "asis"}
empty <- JanisHelpers:::qc_table_empty_(data, "metric")
cat(sum(empty$n_empty), " of ", nrow(data), " values empty.\n\n", sep = "")
print(knitr::kable(empty))
```

## Comments

Free text from the curated sheet's `comment` column (not exported to the
database).

```{r comments, results = "asis"}
comments <- JanisHelpers:::histo_qc_comments_(data, excluded_keys)
if (nrow(comments) == 0) {
  cat("No comments.\n")
} else {
  print(knitr::kable(comments))
}
```

## Sanity rules

```{r rules, results = "asis"}
if (length(qc$rules) == 0) {
  cat("No rules set -- pass `rules` to the prep script to check plausibility ",
      "(e.g. `\"crescents <= gloms\"`).\n", sep = "")
} else {
  viol <- JanisHelpers:::histo_qc_rules_(data, qc$rules)
  if (nrow(viol) == 0) {
    cat("All ", length(qc$rules), " rule(s) hold for every sample.\n", sep = "")
  } else {
    cat("**Warning: rule violations.**\n\n")
    viol$excluded <- ifelse(JanisHelpers:::qc_is_excluded_(viol, excluded_keys),
                            "excluded", "")
    print(knitr::kable(viol))
  }
}
```

## Outliers

Labelled points lie outside their boxplot's whiskers (more
than 1.5 x IQR beyond the quartiles) within group x tissue x timepoint x
metric.

```{r no-group, results = "asis"}
if (is.null(group_col)) {
  note("Group column not set -- rerun the prep script with `group_col` to score outliers.")
}
```

### By group

```{r outliers, results = "asis"}
emit_plot(JanisHelpers:::qc_table_plot_(scored, "metric", group_col, log_scale,
                                        excluded_keys = excluded_keys))
```

## Flagged samples

```{r flags, results = "asis"}
if (is.null(group_col)) {
  note("Not scored -- group column not set.")
} else {
  flags <- JanisHelpers:::qc_table_flag_table_(scored, "metric", excluded_keys)
  if (nrow(flags) == 0) {
    cat("No samples flagged.\n")
  } else {
    cat("Ranked by the number of metrics flagged.\n\n")
    print(knitr::kable(flags))
  }
}
```
